999008199.text: その日、天より一条の光が地上に流れ落ちた

localizations.en: That day, a single light streamed down from the heavens to the earth below.

999008199.text: それは小さな小さな流れ星だった

localizations.en: It was a tiny, tiny shooting star.

999008199.text: 「これはきっと流れ星の導きだ」

localizations.en: "Surely this is guidance from the shooting star."

999008199.text: 「天より祝福がもたらされたのだ」

localizations.en: "A blessing has been bestowed upon us from the heavens."

999008199.text: ノーヴァ神聖国の人々は、口々に希望の言葉を言った

localizations.en: The people of Nova spoke words of hope, one after another.

999008199.text: 「天よりの恵みを、この目で確かめに行こう」

localizations.en: "Let us go and witness this divine gift with our own eyes."

999008199.text: 星が落ちたのは、ノーヴァ神聖国近海にある無人島

localizations.en: The star had fallen on an uninhabited island near the sacred lands of Nova.

999008199.text: 調査団を乗せ、その無人島へと希望の船が旅立った

localizations.en: And so a ship of hope set sail for that island, carrying the investigation team.
